contests.title: Le Mars — Measure RC: Emergency services building bonds

provenance.sourceOrg: Plymouth County Iowa Auditor and Commissioner of Elections
provenance.quote: Shall the City of Le Mars, in Plymouth County, State of Iowa, enter into a loan agreement and issue general obligation bonds in an amount not exceeding $8,000,000 for the purpose of paying the cost, to that extent, of constructing, furnishing and equipping a municipal emergency services building?

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Authorizes up to $8.6 million in general-obligation bonds for renovations, repairs, furnishings, equipment and site improvements at the middle/high school facility.
